_note: Split from the former combined chemicals template. Reg (EU) 2026/405 creates a REAL digital product passport for detergents and end-user surfactants (Art. 21, Annex VI Part A) applying 23 Sep 2029. Shared REACH/CLP identity, hazard and SVHC fields are carried in both this and the paints-coatings template because both product types are chemical mixtures.
